question: In a certain code language, if BOTTLE is coded as CNUUMD, GLASS is coded as HMZTT, then what will MIRROR be coded as?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png]

​BOTTLE is coded as CNUUMD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7378a521123056e1b4e06ea48064bbcfce7556ea1a9f8dd659df087bd98aebba.png]

GLASS is coded as HMZTT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40b4f395b5d0bd3e768a02f0bf5ec8fc548c7a2362739f5c4b898ed5566fae39.png]

MIRROR will be coded as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73b3d6c68ef2abdee018eb625eb0e8689b3ded6a9f06a604761c607faa79b45e.png]
